snippet.title: PUBG: DED.NET | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Cascadia, 1996. 
Death is only the beginning. 

PUBG: DED.NET is a PvP FPS set in a fictional wilderness in the American Pacific Northwest.

Eccentric small towns, labyrinthian forests, and deadly secrets. 
Choose your character and enter the bloody reality show. 
Every game pushes them to the limit until they give up or become a winner. Either way, they'll be back for one more run. 
Stack advantages across multi-match runs, and adapt as conditions shift. 

Learn more about PUBG: DED.NET at https://ded.net/en

Play PUBG: DED.NET on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC when it releases. 

Release date to be announced.


Developer: PUBG STUDIOS 
Publisher: KRAFTON

 #gamescom2026 #PUBGSTUDIOS #DEDNET #KRAFTON
